$comment_plan: q3-rates SFDMU data plan - creates rate cards, rate card entries, rate adjustment tiers, and pricebook-rate card associations. Reload-safe: nothing is deleted; every object matches on its externalId. Pass 1 upserts all objects, inserting a missing RateCardEntry as Draft (RABT requires a Draft parent) and skipping existing entries; pass 2 updates RateCardEntry without Status. activate_rates activates the Draft entries afterwards.
$comment_extraction: SOQL queries include relationship traversal fields (e.g., Product.StockKeepingUnit, RateCard.Name) so this plan works for both import (CSV > org) and extraction (org > CSV). SFDMU v5 does NOT auto-generate $$ composite-key columns during extraction — run scripts/post_process_extraction.py (called automatically by ExtractSFDMUData) before re-importing extracted data.
$comment_ownSchemaObjects: RateCardEntry's key adds ProductSellingModel.Name, and RateAdjustmentByTier references it: qb-rates' four-part headers would drop it (IS001's two entries collapse, and the tiers lose their parent). Post-processing keeps these objects' own columns when it aligns an extraction to qb-rates (todo 319).

objects.query: SELECT Name, ProductCode, StockKeepingUnit, UsageModelType FROM Product2 ORDER BY StockKeepingUnit ASC
SELECT Description, EffectiveFrom, EffectiveTo, Name, Type FROM RateCard ORDER BY Name ASC
SELECT PriceBookId, PriceBook.Name, RateCardId, RateCard.Name, RateCard.Type, RateCardType FROM PriceBookRateCard ORDER BY PriceBook.Name ASC, RateCard.Name ASC, RateCardType ASC

objects.$comment: Pass 1: Upsert + skipExistingRecords inserts a missing entry as Draft (RABT must be inserted under a Draft entry) and never touches an existing one, so Status is never sent to an Active entry. activate_rates activates afterwards. The platform locks every field but Status on an Active entry, so a correction to one needs a new Draft entry or a deactivate/edit/reactivate cycle. ProductSellingModel.Name is part of the key: IS001 has two entries on one card, resource and unit that differ only by selling model (One-Time 9.99, none 3), and without it a reload inserted a duplicate (measured on a fresh 264 q3 build, todo 319). A blank selling model drops out of the $$ value.
objects.query: SELECT DefaultUnitOfMeasureClassId, DefaultUnitOfMeasureClass.Name, DefaultUnitOfMeasureId, DefaultUnitOfMeasure.Name, EffectiveFrom, EffectiveTo, ProductId, Product.StockKeepingUnit, ProductSellingModelId, ProductSellingModel.Name, Rate, RateCardId, RateCard.Name, RateCard.Type, RateNegotiation, RateUnitOfMeasureClassId, RateUnitOfMeasureClass.Name, RateUnitOfMeasureId, RateUnitOfMeasure.UnitCode, RateUnitOfMeasure.Name, Status, UsageResourceId, UsageResource.Code, UsageResource.Name FROM RateCardEntry ORDER BY Product.StockKeepingUnit ASC, RateCard.Name ASC, UsageResource.Code ASC

objects.$comment: Upsert on the traversal key matches on the 5.6.4+ floor. SFDMU drops blank parts of a composite key on the target, so the $$ value omits a blank UpperBound ("...;0", not "...;0;"). An RABT under an Active entry can't be edited; new rows load only under a Draft entry.
objects.query: SELECT AdjustmentType, AdjustmentValue, EffectiveFrom, EffectiveTo, LowerBound, ProductId, Product.StockKeepingUnit, ProductSellingModelId, RateCardEntryId, RateCardEntry.RateCard.Name, RateCardEntryStatus, RateUnitOfMeasureName, RateUnitOfMeasureId, RateUnitOfMeasure.UnitCode, UpperBound, UsageResourceId, UsageResource.Code FROM RateAdjustmentByTier ORDER BY Product.StockKeepingUnit ASC, RateCardEntry.Name ASC, UsageResource.Code ASC, RateUnitOfMeasure.UnitCode ASC
SELECT Name, ProductCode, StockKeepingUnit, UsageModelType FROM Product2 ORDER BY StockKeepingUnit ASC
SELECT Description, EffectiveFrom, EffectiveTo, Name, Type FROM RateCard ORDER BY Name ASC

objects.$comment: Pass 2: corrections to a Draft entry, without Status (objectset_source/object-set-2/RateCardEntry.csv). Product2 and RateCard are declared Readonly so the lookups resolve instead of being sent as null.
objects.query: SELECT DefaultUnitOfMeasureClassId, DefaultUnitOfMeasureClass.Name, DefaultUnitOfMeasureId, DefaultUnitOfMeasure.Name, EffectiveFrom, EffectiveTo, ProductId, Product.StockKeepingUnit, ProductSellingModelId, ProductSellingModel.Name, Rate, RateCardId, RateCard.Name, RateCard.Type, RateNegotiation, RateUnitOfMeasureClassId, RateUnitOfMeasureClass.Name, RateUnitOfMeasureId, RateUnitOfMeasure.UnitCode, RateUnitOfMeasure.Name, UsageResourceId, UsageResource.Code, UsageResource.Name FROM RateCardEntry ORDER BY Product.StockKeepingUnit ASC, RateCard.Name ASC, UsageResource.Code ASC
